decision.reason: W7-05 and W7-06 are blocked and no publish capability is both code_green and operational_ready; production Action adapters remain unregistered

verifiedFoundations: canonical Action Proposal Draft Approval ExecutionLease immutable Receipt and reconcile state chain exists
proposal and approval bind an immutable proposal hash and enforce maker approver executor separation
Action execution is tenant scoped role guarded marking checked and fail-closed when the Adapter is absent
unknown results require a provider request id and authorized provider reread before reconciliation
Canonical Draft Inbox distinguishes approved applied unknown and reconciled and rereads authority after commands
focused generic Action backend and frontend tests are GREEN
blockers: W7-05 Artifact family and W7-06 same-artifact four-gate approval are not GREEN
no versioned publish ActionType defines target object payload diff receipt schema risk capability account adapter and settlement contract
no publish capability has both code_green and operational_ready evidence
ACTION_ADAPTERS has no production registration and its contract only exposes execute and reconcile
no side-effect-free publish dryValidate produces exact platform target account scope diff reversibility rate budget and policy blockers
Action Proposal does not enforce a joint binding to exact selected Variant content hash family selection four-gate decision approval license and module context
generic ResourceRef does not itself carry an Artifact content hash and cannot alone prove the approved bytes are the submitted bytes
the current execution service consumes and commits the lease before the Adapter call leaving a crash window without a durable Attempt or outbox
initial execution Receipt writes empty evidenceRefs and has no reviewed publish-specific post-state schema content hash or platform object observation
Usage settlement lineage and effect review are not automatically joined to the publish action binding hash
webhook inbox replay ordering late receipts cancel and partial platform outcomes are not implemented for Action
manual Handoff is not defined as the mandatory alternative when a platform has no approved API
no rule proves an approval remains valid after Variant family selection Eval license account policy or platform schema drift
no Media Studio Impact preview Draft approval execution receipt reconcile or manual Handoff UI exists
no org-org positive canary kill drill browser evidence or dev-org isolation evidence exists

targetBoundary.candidate: immutable PublishCandidateRevision binds selected Variant content hash family selection four-gate decision approval license and destination context
targetBoundary.impact: side-effect-free ImpactPreviewRevision binds exact candidate platform account scope diff risk reversibility capacity budget policy and adapter dry-validation receipt
targetBoundary.proposal: ActionProposal binds candidate and impact hashes plus exact ActionType capability account adapter policy and idempotency envelope
targetBoundary.approval: Approval authorizes only the exact proposal and candidate hash and becomes stale on any relevant dependency drift
targetBoundary.execution: durable attempt and outbox bridge lease consumption to provider submission without a silent crash window
targetBoundary.receipt: publish-specific Receipt records request fingerprint platform observation exact submitted and observed hashes status evidence and uncertainty
targetBoundary.reconcile: unknown and late provider facts append reconcile receipts and never trigger blind resend
targetBoundary.manual: unsupported or unauthorized platform API produces a scoped manual Handoff with checklist evidence and completion Receipt instead of fake applied
targetBoundary.visibility: Media Studio shows impact approval execution receipt reconcile compensation and effect review as separate lifecycle facts

next: align W7-10 publish contracts and checklist through two review rounds, retain the item unchecked, then preflight W7-11 cumulative gate
safety: no browser or real tenant mutation
no provider publish or payment side effect
